title: CancelTimer - ScriptObject
content:
Member of: ScriptObject Script Cancels the specified real-time timer on this script. Does nothing if that timer has already expired or doesn't exist. Syntax: Function CancelTimer(int aiTimerID = 0) native Parameters: - aiTimerID: The ID of the real-time timer to cancel. The ID is unique per-script and will not conflict with game-time timers. Default: 0 Return Value: None. Examples: ; Cancel pending timer 0 on this script CancelTimer()
; Cancel pending timer 99 on this script CancelTimer(99) See Also: - ScriptObject Script - StartTimer - ScriptObject - OnTimer - ScriptObject
